# Ignite

**Category:** Exploit  
**Aliases:** Ignite

## What it does

Lights players around you on fire if you have flint n' steel on your hotbar

Description basis: [publisher description](https://impactclient.net/features). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).

## Client variants

### [RusherHack — Ignite](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/Ignite.html)
